english: My mother is a doctor. She goes to work at eight in the morning and finishes work at six. At night she goes to bed very early.
reference: 我妈妈是医生。她早上八点上班,六点下班。晚上她很早睡觉。

issues.description: The reference uses 上班 and 下班, which are above HSK 1 (HSK 1 learners would more likely write 去工作 / 工作). 早 in 很早 may also be slightly beyond HSK 1. The grader may reject simpler, correct answers such as 她早上八点去工作 or 六点工作完, so it should accept alternatives.
